title: Edit a message
summary: Edit the text of the person's own message. The composer switches to edit mode with the old text; the message then shows an edited label.

editing.description: The item id being edited. The composer shows bipe_app_edit_banner.

draft.description: The composer text, filled with the old text.

startEdit.effect: From message-actions: sets editing, puts the plain text in the composer and keeps the old draft aside.

cancelEdit.effect: Clears editing and restores the old draft.

save.effect: Timeline.edit with the item id and EditedContent from the new text (messageEventContentFromMarkdown). An unchanged or blank text does nothing. The message shows the new text at once.

notes: The edited label (bipe_app_edited) shows next to the time when MessageContent isEdited is true. No edit history sheet in phase 1.
Only text and captions can be edited. Matrix sets no time limit, and Bipe adds none.
The scam check runs again on the new text (message-scam-warning): an edit keeps the event id, so the warning cache uses the body too (ScamDetector.warningKind).
